title: user_registration_functionality
description: Verify that users can successfully register with valid data and receive appropriate confirmation or error messages for invalid inputs.

title: user_login_and_authentication
description: Test user login with valid and invalid credentials, ensuring secure authentication and correct role assignment.

title: user_logout_process
description: Ensure that authenticated users can log out successfully and that their session is invalidated.

title: submit_manual_fire_alert
description: Validate that users can submit manual fire alerts with geo-tagging and images, and that alerts are stored and retrievable.

title: view_user_own_alerts
description: Check that users can view only their own submitted alerts and that data privacy is maintained.

title: admin_view_all_alerts
description: Verify that admins can view all fire alerts submitted by any user with correct data visibility.

title: admin_manage_forest_areas_crud
description: Test that admins can create, update, and delete forest areas, assign risk levels, and changes reflect correctly on the map.

title: admin_update_weather_data_for_area
description: Ensure admins can update weather data for specific forest areas and that updates are accurately displayed.

title: admin_fire_prediction_settings_toggle
description: Validate that admins can view and toggle fire prediction settings and that automatic alerts respond accordingly.

title: role_based_access_control_enforcement
description: Confirm that all API endpoints enforce authentication and role-based authorization consistently for users and admins.
